Commentary: Prasidh Krishna to Sonal Dinusha, 1 run, 134.1ks back of a length and Dinusha uses the incoming angle, tucks it backward of square. He hops across to the other end. Seems to have done something to his leg - sits down on his knee and recomposes himself

Prasidh Krishna to Lahiru Kumara, no run, uhhh! Kumara backed away even before Prasidh delivered. The line is on the stumps and he manages to get his bat down in time, dabs it to deep backward point and the pair don't take the single. He was a goner had he missed that
Prasidh Krishna to Lahiru Kumara, no run, 137.4ks attempted yorker, but ends up as an inswinging full toss, Kumara squeezes it off the inside-edge to fine leg

16:54 Local Time, 11:24 GMT: Ahsan Raza checks the light. Kumara indicated that he was not able to see Prasidh's ball. It looks to be fine for now. We have a hold up as Dinusha is getting some treatment on his calf by the physio. Meanwhile, the ground staff are making their way to the covers. It has gone gloomy. Siraj is waiting at the top of his mark. Will he be allowed to bowl or will India continue with the spinner? It is going to be Saransh.

Saransh Jain to Sonal Dinusha, no run, turn and bounce. The second new ball has worked better for Saransh. Flighted from round the wicket, Dinusha is drawn into the forward defensive and the ball spins past the outside-edge. Good take by Jurel..
Saransh Jain to Sonal Dinusha, no run, tossed up close to off, Dinusha inside halves the forward block to the on-side
Saransh Jain to Sonal Dinusha, no run, 86.1ks drifting in, Dinusha sits back and defends it down near his feet
Saransh Jain to Sonal Dinusha, leg byes, 1 run, 85.8ks sliding into leg, Dinusha leans forward and misses the glance, off the pad and the duo cross over
Saransh Jain to Lahiru Kumara, no run, defended off the back foot
Saransh Jain to Lahiru Kumara, no run, tosses it up on off, Kumara is not fully forward but manages to defend it in front of silly point
Spin from both ends. It is because of the fading light. Here's Jadeja..
Ravindra Jadeja [19.0-4-44-1] is back into the attack
Ravindra Jadeja to Sonal Dinusha, no run, flighted on off, Dinusha camps back and knocks it with soft hands to mid-wicket
Ravindra Jadeja to Sonal Dinusha, 1 run, couple of steps down the pitch, eases it to long-on and takes a single with four balls to go
Ravindra Jadeja to Lahiru Kumara, no run, spins into leg, Kumara misses the tuck and the ball deflects off the pad to leg slip

Ravindra Jadeja to Lahiru Kumara, no run, appeal for LBW from Jadeja. No one else is interested. Kumara sits down with a cleared front leg to play the slog sweep, misses and is struck on the back thigh. Impact itself was outside leg-stump..

17:02 Local Time, 11:32 GMT: The ground staff are running in with the covers. The players rush off the field. The fourth umpire is walking around with an umbrella. It is raining, not heavy but enough to stop play. Plenty of dark clouds hovering above the ground, so that might be it for the day. Let's wait for the official update..
